results.title: Swiss mountain canton benefits from heat-dodging tourists
results.description: The ongoing heatwave has so far brought a large number of bookings to many tourist areas at higher altitudes. This is particularly noticeable in the mountainous canton of Graubünden in eastern Switzerland. According to a statement issued by Switzerland Tourism, spontaneous bookings are on the rise, particularly among domestic travellers. This is reportedly the case in Graubünden, for example, as noted by Davos-Klosters and Engadin Tourism. The national tourism marketing organisation conducted surveys at Swiss holiday destinations across all language regions. These observations are echoed by the tourism organisation Graubünden Ferien.
